f3_program: collection("drawer.cutlery", "piece_of_cutlery", "cutlery drawer", source("There are 6 forks in the cutlery drawer"))
member("drawer.cutlery", "drawer.cutlery.forks", source("6 forks in the cutlery drawer"))
member("drawer.cutlery", "drawer.cutlery.knives", source("9 more knives than forks"))
member("drawer.cutlery", "drawer.cutlery.spoons", source("twice as many spoons as knives"))
member("drawer.cutlery", "drawer.cutlery.teaspoons", source("half as many teaspoons as forks"))
observe(at("drawer.cutlery.forks.count", "initial"), 6, "count", source("There are 6 forks in the cutlery drawer"))
offset(at("drawer.cutlery.knives.count", "initial"), at("drawer.cutlery.forks.count", "initial"), 9, "count", source("9 more knives than forks"))
multiple(at("drawer.cutlery.spoons.count", "initial"), at("drawer.cutlery.knives.count", "initial"), 2, source("twice as many spoons as knives"))
fraction_of(at("drawer.cutlery.teaspoons.count", "initial"), at("drawer.cutlery.forks.count", "initial"), 1, 2, source("half as many teaspoons as forks"))
add("add_forks", "unspecified", at("drawer.cutlery.forks.count", "current"), 2, source("After 2 of each cutlery is added to the drawer"))
add("add_knives", "unspecified", at("drawer.cutlery.knives.count", "current"), 2, source("After 2 of each cutlery is added to the drawer"))
add("add_spoons", "unspecified", at("drawer.cutlery.spoons.count", "current"), 2, source("After 2 of each cutlery is added to the drawer"))
add("add_teaspoons", "unspecified", at("drawer.cutlery.teaspoons.count", "current"), 2, source("After 2 of each cutlery is added to the drawer"))
query("sum", "drawer.cutlery", "current")
collection("kiddie_pool.water_contributions", "water_volume", "kiddie pool", source("Timmy, Tommy and Tina are filling up a kiddie pool in their backyard"))
member("kiddie_pool.water_contributions", "kiddie_pool.water_contributions.timmy", source("Timmy, Tommy and Tina are filling up a kiddie pool"))
member("kiddie_pool.water_contributions", "kiddie_pool.water_contributions.tommy", source("Timmy, Tommy and Tina are filling up a kiddie pool"))
member("kiddie_pool.water_contributions", "kiddie_pool.water_contributions.tina", source("Timmy, Tommy and Tina are filling up a kiddie pool"))
multiple(at("timmy.pail.capacity", "current"), at("tommy.pail.capacity", "current"), 2, source("Timmy's pail holds twice as much water as Tommy's"))
offset(at("tommy.pail.capacity", "current"), at("tina.pail.capacity", "current"), 2, "gallon", source("Tommy's holds 2 gallons more than Tina's"))
observe(at("tina.pail.capacity", "current"), 4, "gallon", source("Tina's is 4 gallons"))
multiple(at("kiddie_pool.water_contributions.timmy", "after_3_trips"), at("timmy.pail.capacity", "current"), 3, source("after 3 trips each"))
multiple(at("kiddie_pool.water_contributions.tommy", "after_3_trips"), at("tommy.pail.capacity", "current"), 3, source("after 3 trips each"))
multiple(at("kiddie_pool.water_contributions.tina", "after_3_trips"), at("tina.pail.capacity", "current"), 3, source("after 3 trips each"))

add("timmy_three_trips", "timmy", at("kiddie_pool.water.volume", "current"), at("kiddie_pool.water_contributions.timmy", "after_3_trips"), source("Each has a pail they fill with water from a house before dumping it into the pool"))

add("tommy_three_trips", "tommy", at("kiddie_pool.water.volume", "current"), at("kiddie_pool.water_contributions.tommy", "after_3_trips"), source("Each has a pail they fill with water from a house before dumping it into the pool"))

add("tina_three_trips", "tina", at("kiddie_pool.water.volume", "current"), at("kiddie_pool.water_contributions.tina", "after_3_trips"), source("Each has a pail they fill with water from a house before dumping it into the pool"))
query("sum", "kiddie_pool.water_contributions", "after_3_trips")
collection("neighborhood.council_planted_cherry_trees", "cherry_tree", "neighborhood", source("planting cherry trees around the neighborhood"))
observe(at("town_council.cherry_trees.planned.count", "initial"), 7, "count", source("originally intended to plant 7 cherry trees"))

multiple(at("neighborhood.council_planted_cherry_trees.count", "end_of_decade"), at("town_council.cherry_trees.planned.count", "initial"), 2, source("By the end of the decade, they have planted twice as many cherry trees as they originally planned"))

add("plant_cherry_trees", "town_council", at("neighborhood.council_planted_cherry_trees.count", "current"), at("neighborhood.council_planted_cherry_trees.count", "end_of_decade"), source("they have planted twice as many cherry trees as they originally planned"))
observe(at("cherry_tree.leaves_dropped_per_tree.count", "fall"), 100, "count", source("Each tree drops 100 leaves each during the fall"))

product_relation(at("neighborhood.council_planted_cherry_trees.leaves_dropped.count", "fall"), at("neighborhood.council_planted_cherry_trees.count", "end_of_decade"), at("cherry_tree.leaves_dropped_per_tree.count", "fall"), source("Each tree drops 100 leaves each during the fall"))

produce("fall_leaf_drop", "neighborhood.council_planted_cherry_trees", at("neighborhood.fallen_cherry_leaves.count", "current"), at("neighborhood.council_planted_cherry_trees.leaves_dropped.count", "fall"), source("Each tree drops 100 leaves each during the fall"))
query("value", event_field("fall_leaf_drop", "quantity"))
